Hi Ellen / Kim — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. Quick answers and artifacts to unblock Horizon's procurement: 

1) SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II in Nov 2027. Summary report and auditor contact are available here: https://drive.google.com/redwood/soc2-report-2027 (we can provide the full report under NDA).

2) BAA / HIPAA: We support HIPAA-covered workloads and offer a standard BAA. Execution is handled by Legal; I can route a template and next steps after you confirm intent to proceed.

3) Subprocessors (summary):
- Amazon Web Services (compute/storage) — access: yes (platform operations), primary regions: us-east-1, eu-west-1
- Google Cloud Platform (optional model hosting) — access: yes, primary regions: us-central1
- Redis Labs (managed cache) — access: no direct customer data storage, ephemeral KV cache
- Sentry (error monitoring) — access: limited to logs/exceptions, PII redaction enforced
- Segment (analytics) / Snowflake (analytics/warehouse) — access: depends on customer configuration; default is no customer PII sent

I attached an updated table: subprocessor_snapshot_20280412.csv. For each vendor we can provide: role, access (yes/no), primary region(s), subprocessors' SOC reports when available.

4) Data residency & model hosting: We offer EU-only hosting via our Private deployment in eu-west-1. Hosted API customers can pin model instances to EU regions on request; dedicated/private deployments support stricter controls.

5) Retention: Default request/response logs are retained 30 days; token-level telemetry configurable down to 7 days or up to 365 days for enterprise contracts. Logs are deletable on customer request; retention settings are configurable per-tenant in Dedicated/Private modes.

6) Encryption & key management: TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256 at rest. Customers can use their own KMS/HSM in Private deployments; Hosted customers may use Redwood-managed KMS unless a managed KMS integration is contracted.

Next steps I recommend:
- I can provide SOC2 summary and the updated subprocessor CSV (attached).
- Suggest a 30-min security call — proposed slots (PST): Apr 14 10:00–10:30, Apr 14 15:00–15:30, Apr 15 09:00–09:30.

Attachments: subprocessor_snapshot_20280412.csv, dataflow_redwood_horizon.pdf (stub)
